old:
| "const" => return .const (← decodeName (← field j "name"))
      ((← (← arrayField j "levels").mapM decodeLevel).toList)
new:
| "const" =>
    let name ← decodeName (← field j "name")
    let levels ← (← arrayField j "levels").mapM decodeLevel
    return .const name levels.toList
scope: Lean layout only; same identity decoder semantics
